title: Card wording consistency
notes: Same effect, same words: cards that run the same engine verb print the same clause (draw, random discard, steal, Make Radiant, adjacent, gains, Attack and Health, Recruit, Return to hand, (N) Cost, each enemy, Plague Counter placement, damage or heal), and core-073 Anti-oneshot Armor prints 'at a time' like classicplus-011 Anime Armor (#911). Shorter words for long faces: Fortify Mind's rules sentence, Jade Beauty without the Allure reminder its glossary line gives, Jungle Loser's Radiant face without its parenthesis, The Maestro's opponent and piles (#912). Cut to the face's text limit (#1017, R1017000): every face over six lines of 28 characters, which a 170 px face holds at the reading floor, reworded shorter (79 faces on 47 cards); Mind Games, Fortify Mind, YileGPT Unleashed, Yile's Virus and Reach the Summit put the lines their faces print first, and the client prints a short form or a clamp for the cards a list still keeps over it. Tesla's clarification, Jade Beauty's Allure reminder and Jlockheed's Evil Blueprints' 'Piece together the blueprint' return as a last line the face hides behind its '…' (R1017000). Wording only; mechanics, params and numbers unchanged, but for core-050 K-Pop Fanatic (#1045, R1045000), which ships under this claim: its Cry Allures the enemy permanent it chooses, as Jade Beauty Allures every enemy Unit, so its text is shorter, its target carries Allure's pink mark, and a target with no open zone in its row on the stealer's side is destroyed instead of staying with the opponent.

player.title: Card wording consistency
changes: K-Pop Fanatic Allures the enemy permanent it chooses: if you have no room for it when you steal it, it is destroyed.
text: Anti-oneshot Armor reads at a time, matching Anime Armor; nothing plays differently.
Cards that draw say Draw 2, never Draw 2 cards.
Every card that makes a player discard now says the discard is random, as it always was.
Mega Church steals, as Snom Bunny Mind Control does, and Jade Beauty's Allure says it steals the Units it charms.
The Radiant faces of Snom Bunny Mind Control, K-Pop Fanatic and Mega Church say make it Radiant, and Expedition12 says Make a card in your hand Radiant.
Golly Bob Howdy, Polymorph and Mushroom Power say adjacent, as Hit Job and Collateral Damage do.
Death Boil, Normal Grape and Large Grape print one sentence: deal damage to an enemy or heal an ally.
Attack and Health are capitalised on every card, and Mid Loser and Bot Loser gain their stats as other Units do.
Gravedigger returns a card from your graveyard to hand, and Call to Arms recruits Units of (1) Cost or less, as Cookie Guild does.
Permanent Underclassman and Upperclassman summon a (1) and a (4) Cost Unit, and Upperclassman's Death says the fusion goes to your hand.
Rotten Grape says Lose 5 health, Jlockeed Shredder-10 hits each enemy, Fed Fauci places its Plague Counter and Claude's Datacenter adds an AI generated card.
Fortify Mind says who beats whom in one short sentence, and The Maestro names your opponent's field, hand, deck and graveyard.
Jade Beauty no longer repeats what Allure does, which the keyword's glossary line says; Jungle Loser's Radiant face drops its reminder in brackets.
Over forty cards say the same in fewer words, so no card's art shrinks to make room for its text. Nothing plays differently.
Reach the Summit, Heroic Power, Combo-Index, Mind Games, Fortify Mind, YileGPT Unleashed and Call to Chaos show their first lines and …; hover one to read all of it on its left.
Tesla, Jade Beauty and Jlockheed's Evil Blueprints keep a reminder or a line of flavour after their …, there to read when you hover them.
